caption: 💌 Save this recipe before you forget where you saw it. 📩 SHARE it with a mama who still buys “healthy” bread at the store. 🌿  The Only Whole Wheat Bread You’ll Ever Need 🍞 soft, moist, and packed with real nutrition. 👌 Perfect for toddler snacks, morning toast, or calm family dinners. No refined flour. No sugar. No additives. Just 5 real ingredients, full of fiber, minerals, and calm energy for moms and toddlers. 🌾 🥣 Ingredients: 1 tbsp (10g) active dry yeast 1 tsp (5g) honey 60 ml warm water (for activation) 4 cups (600g) whole wheat flour 2 cups (480 ml) hot water 1 tsp (6g) fine salt 2 tbsp (20 ml) olive oil 🧡 Method: 1️⃣ Activate yeast mix with warm water + honey, rest 5 min. 2️⃣ Add flour, hot water, salt, olive oil. Mix until dough forms. 3️⃣ Cover and rest 1 hour (room temp, warm spot). 4️⃣ Deflate, and place in a loaf tin. Rest 15 min. 5️⃣ Bake at 190°C (375°F) for 45 min with a small dish of water in the oven,💡this creates natural steam for a soft, golden crust. 🥖 Texture tip: this dough is meant to be slightly sticky, don’t overwork it. That’s what keeps it soft and airy. ✨ Result: a rich, nutty whole wheat loaf that stays moist for 3 days.  #wholewheatbread #realfoodmama #homemadebread #norefinedflour #softnutrition
